title: A peer's long completion never fails another session's read words
outcome: An explicit show REF reads committed state during a peer's write transaction without depending on the session-local focus write; ordinary focus bookkeeping never makes a read unavailable
acceptance: Explicit-target correctness is preserved when focus cannot be updated: the receipt and its navigation refer to the requested item and never silently fall back to an older focus, and no staged delivery page is consumed, discarded or advanced because a read was attempted
Mutation authority, claims and fencing are unchanged, and a genuine mutation after such a read still targets the requested work with the same authority checks

Regression: one connection holds a write transaction beyond the busy timeout while another session runs show REF; the read succeeds with the requested item, no focus fallback and no staged-page side effect, and a following mutation from the reader is authorized exactly as before

show REF and any other explicitly targeted read word return the requested item's committed state while another session holds a long write transaction, without requiring the convenience focus write to succeed first; a typed busy refusal is reserved for genuine resource unavailability, not focus bookkeeping
